Parameters:

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "apply_migration",
      "parameters": "{\"name\":\"validate_czu_email_domain\",\"query\":\"-- Migration: Server-side CZU email domain validation\\n-- Purpose: Ensures that email addresses being changed must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\\n-- This uses SECURITY DEFINER to create a trigger on auth.users table for true server-side enforcement\\n-- The trigger runs at the database level and cannot be bypassed by client-side code\\n\\n-- Create validation trigger function with SECURITY DEFINER\\n-- SECURITY DEFINER allows the function to access auth.users table even when called by regular users\\n-- This provides true server-side enforcement at the Supabase database level\\ncreate or replace function public.validate_czu_email_domain_trigger()\\nreturns trigger\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity definer\\nset search_path = public, auth\\nas $$\\ndeclare\\n  v_email text;\\n  v_email_change text;\\n  v_domain text;\\nbegin\\n  -- Only validate on UPDATE (email changes), not INSERT (new user creation)\\n  -- This allows OAuth signups (Google, etc.) to create accounts with any email\\n  if tg_op != 'UPDATE' then\\n    return NEW;\\n  end if;\\n\\n  -- Validate email_change field (where Supabase stores new email during change process)\\n  -- This applies to ALL users (both OAuth and email-only)\\n  -- OAuth users can sign up, but when they try to add an email identity, it must be CZU domain\\n  if OLD.email_change is distinct from NEW.email_change then\\n    v_email_change := NEW.email_change;\\n    \\n    -- Skip validation if email_change is null or empty\\n    if v_email_change is not null and v_email_change != '' then\\n      -- Extract domain from email_change (everything after @)\\n      v_domain := lower(split_part(v_email_change, '@', 2));\\n      \\n      -- Validate domain is one of the allowed CZU domains\\n      -- This applies to all users, including OAuth users trying to add email identity\\n      if v_domain not in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz') then\\n        raise exception 'Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz. Provided domain: %', v_domain;\\n      end if;\\n    end if;\\n  end if;\\n\\n  -- Validate email field if it changed\\n  -- For OAuth users: validate when they're changing from OAuth email to a new email\\n  -- For email-only users: always validate\\n  if OLD.email is distinct from NEW.email then\\n    v_email := NEW.email;\\n    \\n    -- Skip validation if email is null or empty\\n    if v_email is not null and v_email != '' then\\n      -- Extract domain from email (everything after @)\\n      v_domain := lower(split_part(v_email, '@', 2));\\n      \\n      -- Validate domain is one of the allowed CZU domains\\n      -- This applies to all users when changing primary email\\n      if v_domain not in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz') then\\n        raise exception 'Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz. Provided domain: %', v_domain;\\n      end if;\\n    end if;\\n  end if;\\n\\n  return NEW;\\nend;\\n$$;\\n\\n-- Grant execute permission to authenticated and anonymous roles\\n-- This allows the trigger to execute when users update their email\\ngrant execute on function public.validate_czu_email_domain_trigger() to authenticated;\\ngrant execute on function public.validate_czu_email_domain_trigger() to anon;\\n\\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table\\n-- This fires BEFORE any update to email or email_change columns\\n-- The trigger cannot be bypassed - it runs at the database level\\ndrop trigger if exists validate_czu_email_domain_trigger on auth.users;\\n\\ncreate trigger validate_czu_email_domain_trigger\\nbefore update of email, email_change on auth.users\\nfor each row\\nexecute function public.validate_czu_email_domain_trigger();\\n\\n-- Add comment explaining the security model\\ncomment on function public.validate_czu_email_domain_trigger() is \\n'Server-side trigger function that validates email domains at the database level. Uses SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table. Cannot be bypassed by client-side code. Allows OAuth signups (INSERT) but validates email changes (UPDATE) for all users, including OAuth users trying to add email identities.';\"}",
      "serverName": "supabase"
    }
  ]
}
```

Parameters:

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "apply_migration",
      "parameters": "{\"name\":\"restrict_signups_to_google_oauth\",\"query\":\"-- Migration: Restrict signups to Google OAuth only\\n-- Purpose: Blocks email/password signups and OTP signups, only allows Google OAuth\\n-- This ensures all new accounts must be created via Google OAuth\\n\\n-- Create before_user_created hook in public schema to only allow Google OAuth signups\\n-- Blocks email/password signups and other OAuth providers\\n-- Uses public schema instead of auth schema\\ncreate or replace function public.before_user_created_hook(event jsonb)\\nreturns jsonb\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity definer\\nset search_path = ''\\nas $$\\ndeclare\\n  v_provider text;\\n  v_encrypted_password text;\\n  v_app_metadata jsonb;\\n  v_identity jsonb;\\n  v_has_google_identity boolean := false;\\nbegin\\n  -- Extract encrypted_password first (most reliable indicator of password signup)\\n  v_encrypted_password := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;&gt;'encrypted_password';\\n  \\n  -- Block password-based signups immediately (they have encrypted_password)\\n  if v_encrypted_password is not null then\\n    raise exception 'Password-based signups are not allowed. Please use Google OAuth to sign in.';\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  -- Extract provider from multiple possible locations\\n  -- 1. raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'provider'\\n  v_provider := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'raw_user_meta_data'-&gt;&gt;'provider';\\n  \\n  -- 2. app_metadata-&gt;&gt;'provider'\\n  v_app_metadata := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'app_metadata';\\n  if v_provider is null and v_app_metadata is not null then\\n    v_provider := v_app_metadata-&gt;&gt;'provider';\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  -- 3. Check identities array for Google provider (most reliable for OAuth)\\n  if event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'identities' is not null then\\n    for v_identity in \\n      select value from jsonb_array_elements(event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'identities')\\n    loop\\n      if v_identity-&gt;&gt;'provider' = 'google' then\\n        v_has_google_identity := true;\\n        exit;\\n      end if;\\n    end loop;\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  -- Allow Google OAuth signups (check both provider variable and identities array)\\n  if v_provider = 'google' or v_has_google_identity then\\n    return event;\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  -- If we reach here, it's not a Google OAuth signup and not a password signup\\n  -- This must be an OTP or other email-based signup attempt\\n  raise exception 'Only Google OAuth signups are allowed. Please use Google to sign in.';\\nend;\\n$$;\\n\\n-- Grant execute permission (needed for hook execution)\\ngrant execute on function public.before_user_created_hook(jsonb) to authenticated;\\ngrant execute on function public.before_user_created_hook(jsonb) to anon;\\n\\n-- Note: Also update supabase/config.toml:\\n-- [auth.email]\\n-- enable_signup = false\\n--\\n-- [auth.hook.before_user_created]\\n-- enabled = true\\n-- uri = \\\"pg-functions://postgres/public/before_user_created_hook\\\"\"}",
      "serverName": "supabase"
    }
  ]
}
```

```json
{
  "tools": [

      "name": "apply_migration",
      "parameters": "{\"name\":\"create_user_stuff\",\"query\":\"-- Migration: Create users, profiles, and teams schema with realtime support\\n-- Purpose: Creates custom users table (replacing auth.users reference), profiles table, teams table\\n-- Includes automatic updated_at triggers and realtime broadcasting for users table\\n-- Affected tables: users, profiles, teams\\n-- Special considerations: Users table is separate from auth.users, profiles reference users table\\n\\n-- Create profile_role enum for profiles table\\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\\n\\n-- Create users table (custom table, separate from auth.users)\\n-- Stores Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking\\n-- Linked to auth.users via auth_user_id for authentication checks\\ncreate table public.users (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  auth_user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\\n  google_email text not null unique,\\n  suggested_work_email text,\\n  google_profile_picture text,\\n  google_full_name text,\\n  last_otp_sent_at timestamptz,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\\n);\\n\\ncomment on table public.users is 'Custom users table storing Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking. Separate from auth.users but linked via auth_user_id for authentication.';\\n\\n-- Create teams table\\ncreate table public.teams (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  picture text,\\n  color text,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\\n);\\n\\ncomment on table public.teams is 'Team information for organizing users into groups.';\\n\\n-- Create profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\\n-- References the new users table instead of auth.users\\ncreate table public.profiles (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  picture text,  -- defaults to Google profile picture on link\\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\\n  work_email text unique not null,\\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\\n  phone_number text,\\n  personal_email text,\\n  date_of_birth date,\\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\\n  )\\n);\\n\\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification.';\\n\\n-- Create trigger function to automatically update updated_at column\\n-- This function will be used by all tables with updated_at columns\\ncreate or replace function public.handle_updated_at()\\nreturns trigger\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity invoker\\nset search_path = ''\\nas $$\\nbegin\\n  -- Update the updated_at column to current timestamp on any update\\n  new.updated_at := now();\\n  return new;\\nend;\\n$$;\\n\\ncomment on function public.handle_updated_at() is 'Trigger function that automatically updates the updated_at column to the current timestamp on row updates.';\\n\\n-- Create triggers for updated_at on all tables\\ncreate trigger users_updated_at_trigger\\nbefore update on public.users\\nfor each row\\nexecute function public.handle_updated_at();\\n\\ncreate trigger teams_updated_at_trigger\\nbefore update on public.teams\\nfor each row\\nexecute function public.handle_updated_at();\\n\\ncreate trigger profiles_updated_at_trigger\\nbefore update on public.profiles\\nfor each row\\nexecute function public.handle_updated_at();\\n\\n-- Enable realtime publication for users table\\nalter publication supabase_realtime add table public.users;\\n\\n-- Create trigger function for realtime broadcasting on users table\\n-- Uses realtime.broadcast_changes for database change notifications\\ncreate or replace function public.users_realtime_broadcast_trigger()\\nreturns trigger\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity definer\\nset search_path = ''\\nas $$\\nbegin\\n  -- Broadcast changes to users table using dedicated topic pattern\\n  -- Topic format: users:{user_id} for user-specific updates\\n  perform realtime.broadcast_changes(\\n    tg_table_name || ':' || coalesce(new.id, old.id)::text,\\n    tg_op,\\n    tg_op,\\n    tg_table_name,\\n    tg_table_schema,\\n    new,\\n    old\\n  );\\n  return coalesce(new, old);\\nend;\\n$$;\\n\\ncomment on function public.users_realtime_broadcast_trigger() is 'Trigger function that broadcasts changes to the users table via Supabase Realtime. Uses dedicated topic pattern users:{user_id}.';\\n\\n-- Create trigger for realtime broadcasting on users table\\ncreate trigger users_realtime_broadcast_trigger\\nafter insert or update or delete on public.users\\nfor each row\\nexecute function public.users_realtime_broadcast_trigger();\\n\\n-- Create indexes for common queries\\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\\ncreate index profiles_team_id_idx on public.profiles(team_id);\\ncreate index users_google_email_idx on public.users(google_email);\\ncreate index users_suggested_work_email_idx on public.users(suggested_work_email);\\ncreate index users_auth_user_id_idx on public.users(auth_user_id);\\n\\n-- Enable Row Level Security on all tables\\nalter table public.users enable row level security;\\nalter table public.profiles enable row level security;\\nalter table public.teams enable row level security;\\n\\n-- RLS Policies for users table\\n-- Users can view their own user record (via auth_user_id link to auth.users)\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can view their own user record\\\" on public.users\\nfor select\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) );\\n\\n-- Users can update their own user record\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can update their own user record\\\" on public.users\\nfor update\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) )\\nwith check ( auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) );\\n\\n-- Allow authenticated users to insert their own user record (during signup)\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can insert their own user record\\\" on public.users\\nfor insert\\nto authenticated\\nwith check ( auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) );\\n\\n-- RLS Policies for profiles table\\n-- Users can view their own profile (via user_id -&gt; users.auth_user_id -&gt; auth.uid())\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can view their own profile\\\" on public.profiles\\nfor select\\nto authenticated\\nusing (\\n  user_id in (\\n    select id\\n    from public.users\\n    where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())\\n  )\\n);\\n\\n-- Users can view profiles in their team (for team collaboration)\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can view profiles in their team\\\" on public.profiles\\nfor select\\nto authenticated\\nusing (\\n  team_id in (\\n    select team_id\\n    from public.profiles\\n    where user_id in (\\n      select id\\n      from public.users\\n      where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())\\n    )\\n  )\\n);\\n\\n-- Admins can view all profiles (role check via application logic)\\n-- For now, allow authenticated users to view all profiles\\n-- Application layer should enforce admin-only access\\ncreate policy \\\"Authenticated users can view all profiles\\\" on public.profiles\\nfor select\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( true );\\n\\n-- Only admins can insert profiles (enforced by application layer)\\ncreate policy \\\"Authenticated users can insert profiles\\\" on public.profiles\\nfor insert\\nto authenticated\\nwith check ( true );\\n\\n-- Users can update their own profile\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can update their own profile\\\" on public.profiles\\nfor update\\nto authenticated\\nusing (\\n  user_id in (\\n    select id\\n    from public.users\\n    where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())\\n  )\\n)\\nwith check (\\n  user_id in (\\n    select id\\n    from public.users\\n    where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())\\n  )\\n);\\n\\n-- Admins can update any profile (enforced by application layer)\\ncreate policy \\\"Authenticated users can update profiles\\\" on public.profiles\\nfor update\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( true )\\nwith check ( true );\\n\\n-- RLS Policies for teams table\\n-- All authenticated users can view teams\\ncreate policy \\\"Authenticated users can view teams\\\" on public.teams\\nfor select\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( true );\\n\\n-- Only admins can insert teams (enforced by application layer)\\ncreate policy \\\"Authenticated users can insert teams\\\" on public.teams\\nfor insert\\nto authenticated\\nwith check ( true );\\n\\n-- Only admins can update teams (enforced by application layer)\\ncreate policy \\\"Authenticated users can update teams\\\" on public.teams\\nfor update\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( true )\\nwith check ( true );\\n\\n-- Only admins can delete teams (enforced by application layer)\\ncreate policy \\\"Authenticated users can delete teams\\\" on public.teams\\nfor delete\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( true );\\n\\n-- Create index for RLS policy performance on profiles.team_id\\n-- This index helps with the \\\"Users can view profiles in their team\\\" policy\\ncreate index profiles_team_id_user_id_idx on public.profiles(team_id, user_id);\\n\\n-- RLS Policies for realtime.messages table (required for private channels)\\n-- Users can receive broadcasts for their own user record\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can receive broadcasts for their own user record\\\" on realtime.messages\\nfor select\\nto authenticated\\nusing (\\n  topic like 'users:%' and\\n  exists (\\n    select 1\\n    from public.users\\n    where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())\\n    and topic = 'users:' || id::text\\n  )\\n);\\n\\n-- Index for realtime.messages RLS policy performance\\ncreate index if not exists idx_realtime_messages_topic on realtime.messages(topic);\"}",
```
